Kiro in Your CI/CD Pipeline

Kiro isn't just for your local machine.
The headless Kiro CLI runs inside CI/CD pipelines.
It can execute specs and tasks as part of your build.
Agentic development, automated all the way to deploy.

Episode 68 of theAIgurukul's free Kiro series, a daily short on AWS's agentic IDE. Subscribe for the next one.
